description: Governance Rules v2 bind human decisions, notice requirements, timers and appeal routes to the selected Workflow. These declarations require graph validation and independently supplied runtime capabilities; they do not prove that an email was sent or grant provider authority.

version.description: Version of this original Rules document. Version 2 selects the closed schema and its actual Workflow and IntegrationProfile association checks.

humanDecisions.description: Human decision bindings identify the task, transition and accepted evidence required for each covered determination.

rules.description: Retained demonstration rule, not a legal authority.
Retained demonstration rule, not a legal authority.

noticeRequirements.description: Required notice observations keyed by the exact IntegrationProfile callback binding identifier. An observation declaration requires independent runtime support before use.

dueProcess.description: Original notice requirement and exact transitions or case values protected before an adverse proposal can take effect.

timeoutDecisions.description: No-response decisions tie actual timer transitions to the original request notice and the complete correction tasks.

rule.description: Retained demonstration rule, not a legal authority.

appeal.description: Applicant filing and independently assigned human review associated with concrete tasks and transitions in the selected Workflow.

noticeTimers.description: Original notice-anchored elapsed periods. Each exact timer start and consuming transition must follow qualified callback Mapping; no no-response decision or missing-response claim is implied.

GovernanceTransition.description: An exact actual transition, using global state identifiers.

from.description: Global identifier of the actual source state in the selected Workflow. It must resolve with the target and event to the declared transition.

to.description: Global identifier of the actual target state in the selected Workflow. A matching state name alone does not establish the required transition.

event.description: Exact authored message name or native event label consumed by this transition, such as the timer label $timeout.response.

ref.description: Reference selecting the maintained Formspec Mapping applied to the unchanged accepted Response when extracting decision evidence.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the selected Mapping file bytes, prefixed with sha256:. The all-zero example is illustrative and does not qualify an actual file.

HumanDecisionBinding.description: Actual human decision coverage and permitted original evidence.

transition.description: Actual determination transition covered by this human decision binding; its task and evidence must resolve in the same selected Workflow.

taskRef.description: Workflow-local task declaration whose accepted artifact supplies the structured human judgment for the selected transition.

evidencePointer.description: JSON Pointer to the structured decision evidence inside the actual accepted task artifact; this does not name an arbitrary external record.

evidenceMapping.description: Optional immutable Formspec Mapping selected by reference and raw-file digest to extract evidence from the accepted Response.

rules.description: Exact rule references permitted as support for this decision by the selected policy. The references do not establish legal authority by themselves.

examples.description: Retained demonstration rule, not a legal authority.

items.description: Complete criterion identifiers the selected human decision must address in its retained evidence Each entry retains the exact identifier or path selected by the policy.

criteria.description: Complete criterion identifiers the selected human decision must address in its retained evidence.

items.description: JSON Pointers selecting case-file values that the policy permits in the retained decision-evidence snapshot Each entry retains the exact identifier or path selected by the policy.

caseFieldPaths.description: JSON Pointers selecting case-file values that the policy permits in the retained decision-evidence snapshot.

items.description: Controllable criterion or factor identifiers permitted in positive counterfactual evidence for the selected decision Each entry retains the exact identifier or path selected by the policy.

positiveFactors.description: Controllable criterion or factor identifiers permitted in positive counterfactual evidence for the selected decision.

items.description: Irrelevant factor identifiers that the human review must explicitly exclude from its decision reasoning Each entry retains the exact identifier or path selected by the policy.

negativeFactors.description: Irrelevant factor identifiers that the human review must explicitly exclude from its decision reasoning.

ProtectedGovernanceEffect.description: Actual finite protected adverse case values.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the case-file value protected from becoming adverse before its selected notice requirement is satisfied.

adverseValues.description: Finite values representing adverse treatment at this case-file path. Declaring them protects the write; it does not authorize it.

DueProcessBinding.description: Original required notice and actual protected continuations.

noticeBindingId.description: Exact callback binding identifier in noticeRequirements and the selected IntegrationProfile for the required adverse-decision notice.

effectiveTransitions.description: Actual transitions allowed to make the original proposal effective after the selected notice requirement has been satisfied.

protectedEffects.description: Case-file paths and adverse values subject to the same required notice, including writes produced by task Mapping.

TimeoutDecisionBinding.description: Actual no-response transition and original notice clock.

transition.description: Actual unconditional timeout transition evaluated with the retained timer and complete task evidence for this no-response decision.

timerId.description: Identifier of the actual retained native timer whose event drives this decision. Qualification checks its authored start and continuation.

responsePeriod.description: Whole-calendar-day response duration, such as P90D, matched to the authored timer and anchored to the original qualifying notice observation.

requestNoticeBindingId.description: Exact callback binding identifier for the original request notice whose qualifying observation anchors this response period.

items.description: Complete correction-task declarations considered before this no-response rule can determine that the requested response is absent Each entry retains the exact identifier or path selected by the policy.

correctionTaskRefs.description: Complete correction-task declarations considered before this no-response rule can determine that the requested response is absent.

rule.description: Explicit selected policy rule supporting the no-response decision. The declaration does not establish an independent legal source.

examples.description: Retained demonstration rule, not a legal authority.

reconsiderationRoute.description: Identifier of the maintained late-evidence or reconsideration route named by the selected rule and exposed by the authored workflow.

items.description: Factor identifiers excluded from the restricted inputs of this no-response rule; absence of a response does not supply those facts Each entry retains the exact identifier or path selected by the policy.

excludedFactors.description: Factor identifiers excluded from the restricted inputs of this no-response rule; absence of a response does not supply those facts.

AppealBinding.description: Original filing and separately assigned human reconsideration.

policyLabel.description: Authored label identifying this reconsideration policy in retained evidence; the label alone does not assert legal authority.

reviewBody.description: Human-readable name of the independent reconsideration body included in the original notice and retained appeal information.

filingInstructions.description: Human-readable directions for filing an appeal through the authored applicant task, as included in the original notice.

filedTaskRef.description: Workflow-local applicant filing task whose accepted completion provides the real appeal request for the filing transition.

proposalReferencePointer.description: JSON Pointer to the original proposal Facts reference in the accepted appeal artifact, preserving the decision being challenged.

reviewTaskRef.description: Workflow-local task declaration for independently assigned human reconsideration of the original proposal.

reviewerActor.description: Identifier of the declared human reviewer actor, selected separately from the original decision maker in this Workflow.

filedTransition.description: Actual transition consuming completion of the applicant filing task and entering the authored appeal-review path.

reviewTransitions.description: Actual reconsideration transitions, each also covered by a human decision binding and its accepted evidence.

NoticeTimerBinding.description: Explicit elapsed period anchored to one original qualified notice, independent of whether a response was received.

transition.description: Exact unconditional native timer transition continuing an elapsed period; this does not determine that a response is absent.

timerId.description: Identifier of the actual retained native timer whose event drives this decision. Qualification checks its authored start and continuation.

requestNoticeBindingId.description: Exact callback binding whose original qualified notice observation anchors the elapsed period.

duration.description: Original whole-calendar-day elapsed duration matched to the authored native timer, without any absence-of-response condition.
